Bharat ne sanyukt rashtr mahasbha (UNGA) men phalastini logon aur kabze vale siriyaee golan ki aabadi ke prakritik sansadhnon par adhikaron ki pushti karne vale prastav ke paksh men matdan kiya. prastav men izrail se in kshetron men prakritik sansadhnon ka dohan aur unhen nuksan pahunchana band karne ki mang ki gaee.
Thank you for watching our video!
